name: Lansing (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and navy blue, the white charged with three yellow stars for the three original districts of Oak Glen, Bernice and Lansing.
history: Lansing is a village in Cook County, Illinois. The flag was adopted in 2008 (announced by the village as its official flag in October 2008 after a contest run by the Lansing Historical Society, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: three stars for the three original districts
